QUOTE: Add the macro to the module's public header (e.g. `include/mbedtls/cipher.h`)... Regenerate the switch cases in `library/error.c`. The two switch bodies are marked `/* Begin Auto-Generated Code. */`... Do not hand-edit that block.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the workflow of adding a macro to the header, then regenerating and not hand-editing error.c. But it never says the header macro needs a `/** */` doc comment, and it says it could not confirm where the generator gets its description text, so the string-from-doc-comment mechanism the item requires is missing.
